versions.changelog: Sharpen the vision phrasing: scrolling demos *is* the dev loop, not a review/QA layer on top. The video is the spec — see a take, tell AI what's off, swipe to the next version, stop when one matches. README + SKILL.md updated. No code changes.

Reframe README + SKILL.md around the vibe-coding test loop. The cursor trick is how it works; the why — and the reason to install this — is that after vibe-coding a feature, you still need to test it visually and show it to a teammate, and manual screen recording is friction every time. No code changes.

v0.2.0: persistent mask regions for sensitive UI areas (configured in record.js, blurred as the top ffmpeg composition layer) + new 4th review pass 'sensitive' that crops mask regions for blur verification and samples full frames every 10s for unmasked-PII detection. Agent guidance updated to require asking about masks before recording and reading review/sensitive/ before declaring done.
Rename: screencast-demo → screencast-studio. Old name read as 'a demo of screencast' rather than 'a tool for recording demos'. No functional changes.

Initial public release. Subtitled cursor-overlay screencast pipeline (Playwright + ffmpeg). 8 templates + 5 references + anonymized walkthrough example with sample output (final.mp4 + 4 frames). Cross-platform CJK font detection (Windows / macOS / Linux).
